folds.text: Sometimes the answer misses. That is normal, and it is rarely a reason to give up. Most misses can be fixed with one good follow-up.
First, work out what went wrong. Was it the wrong tone, too long, missing something, or just incorrect? Naming the problem is half the fix.

items: Say exactly what is wrong: "too formal", "you skipped the second question".
Add the context you left out the first time.
Still stuck? Start a fresh chat with a better first prompt.

folds.text: If an answer seems factually wrong, ask Claude to check again and give its source, then verify it yourself. Do not just ask for the same thing a third time.

folds.question: Claude wrote a 500-word summary, but you wanted something short. Which follow-up is best?
options: Too long. Cut it to three bullet points, keeping the main decision.
Why did you write so much?
folds.why: It names the problem and says what you want instead. Vague complaints make Claude guess.
